title: applied-ml-experiment-scratchpad-2026-03-20-jordan
content:
2026-03-20 - daily scratchpad (quick notes, runs, todos)

Top-level goal: get 4-bit quantized Redwood-7B variant to match ~98% of fp16 quality on MMLU/BBH-ish prompts while shaving token-cost by ~2.5x.

TODOS (short):
- [ ] finish sweep for act-order + group-size for PTQ (start with groups 64/128)
- [ ] run baseline eval on fp16 Redwood-7B (latest weights) for prompt-set v3 (regression targets)
- [ ] sanity-check kallidiff for SFT prompts and make tags for failing prompts
- [ ] sync with Maya on deployment config for dedicated test queue (throughput lane)
- [ ] write quick doc with recommended quant knobs for infra (for console team)

Notes from today:
- did PTQ run with bitsandbytes 0.41 + custom qconfig (use per-channel symmetric, 4-bit, outlier aware) on 7B.
- preliminary MMLU (subset) numbers: fp16 baseline: 67.2, PTQ-4b naive: 61.8, PTQ-4b + act-order swap + group64: 64.9
- observed hallucination spike on generative reasoning tasks (BBH-qual) when using group128; seems to correlate with activation clipping in early layers.
- KV cache behavior fine; no segfaults seen on 2048 context runs.

Quick results table (subset):
Model | Config | MMLU-sub | BBH-qual (pass@1)
Redwood-7B | fp16 | 67.2 | 52
Redwood-7B | 4b-ptq-naive | 61.8 | 40
Redwood-7B | 4b-ptq-group64+act-swap | 64.9 | 47
Redwood-7B | 4b-ptq-group128 | 63.5 | 44

Interpretation: group64 + act-order swap gets us most way there; still ~2.3 points MMLU gap vs fp16. Need to test QAT small run (100k steps) on hardest prompts to see quality delta. If QAT closes gap by 1.5+ points, cost tradeoff might be worth it for enterprise customers.

Prompt set notes (prompt-set-v3):
- includes 1) system instructions + 2) 12-shot exemplars for reasoning tasks + 3) few-shot math and code-run prompts.
- few prompts that fail under quantization are long-chain reasoning with heavy intermediate token reuse; hypothesis: quantization error accumulates on intermediate latent states exposed by long chains.
- action: create filtered subset of 120 prompts (v3-filtered) to monitor regressions more quickly in CI.

Commands / reproducible steps used today:
- export QCONFIG=custom_4b_actswap_group64.json
- python tools/quantize.py --model checkpoints/redwood-7b/fp16 --out models/redwood-7b-4b-ptq-g64 --qconfig $QCONFIG --backend bitsandbytes
- python eval/run_eval.py --model models/redwood-7b-4b-ptq-g64 --prompts tests/promptsets/prompt-set-v3.json --metrics mmlu,bbh --batch 8 --context 2048
- local profiling: python infra/profiler.py --model models/redwood-7b-4b-ptq-g64 --tokens 10000 --warm 2 --device cuda:0

Bugs / oddities noticed:
- one run on p4dn (cuda11) crashed with CUBLAS_STATUS_EXECUTION_FAILED at step ~1200 in quantize tool. Repro: try quantize with same qconfig and small subset (toy) to replicate. Might be kernel selection; open PR to pinned cuda/torch combo? linked: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rv-runtime/pull/789
- inference server logs show occasional OOMs when running multiple concurrent 512-context requests on dedicated small-gpu. Possibly poor batching heuristics for quantized kernels.

Ideas / next experiments:
- small QAT: copy sft-checkpoint + 100k steps LORA-style to only bias small weights, then quantize and re-eval. Cheapish if we do on k80 pool? (ask infra).
- try per-token dynamic scaling for outliers (per-channel adaptive) — implement quick prototype to check impact on MMLU.
- add targeted eval for long-chain-repeat prompts to CI (v3-longchain).

Questions for Maya/Liam:
- Maya: can you allocate 1x a10g for 12h for QAT prototype?
- Liam: can infra add a small dedicated queue with the new quant kernels so we can simulate concurrency?

Linked tickets / refs:
- ML-452: quantization sweep tracking (owner: Jordan)
- CON-1234: deployment plan for dedicated quant-test queue (owner: Maya)
- PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/rv-runtime/pull/789: kernel pinning / cublas workaround (WIP)

Scratch ideas (notes to self):
- keep a running list of failing prompts and tag them by failure mode (hallucination, truncation, arithmetic error).
- when backfilling CI, include perf counters for token throughput + kernel time percent.

Short daily log:
- 09:00-10:30 baseline fp16 eval + prepare prompt-set v3-filtered
- 10:30-13:00 PTQ sweep (groups 32/64/128) + early analysis
- 13:00-14:00 lunch / sync with product (quick check)
- 14:00-16:00 ran group64 act-swap full eval; repro of BBH issues on group128
- 16:00-17:30 debug crash on p4dn, drafted PR to runtime

Next steps (tomorrow):
- run QAT prototype on narrow dataset (legal-reasoning-ish) and compare MMLU delta
- curate v3-filtered to 120 prompts and add to CI harness (fast path)
- follow up with Maya on queue and Liam on kernel rollout schedule

Misc quick links:
- internal confluence: https://redwoodai.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/Quant+Playbook
- eval dashboard (dev): https://console.redwood.ai/eval/runs/2026-03-20-jordan

Notes-to-self: keep entries brief, timestamp runs, push failing prompts to ML-452 for tracking.

-- Jordan
